content: Vikram Patel from Omni Insurance Group called Aditya Singh to confirm property details for his home insurance policy activation. They verified the correct address (24/5 Green Valley, 12th Main Road, Bangalore 560001) and construction type (RCC structure, 2 BHK). Aditya agreed to the annual premium of INR 12,500, and Vikram confirmed he would set the policy status to active and send the documents via email.
